verdicts.reason: A breaks the grouping: the attribution sits bottom-left under the quote mark, away from the quote, which floats in the centre. Reading left to right, the eye hits the attribution before the quote. The SOLSTICE logo is dropped, and the product is a tiny orange blob on the right. B keeps the quote mark, quote and attribution together in one left-aligned block, which is better. But its attribution is jammed against the quote and the bottom edge, the logo shrinks to an unreadable speck crowded beside the attribution, and the quote text is about 8–9px, too small to read. Both waste the middle-right area and reduce the product to an unrecognisable icon.
